{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Final verification: no QA rows
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
assert qa_count == 0, f'Expected 0 QA rows, found {qa_count}'

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Output
mean_revenue"}
